prompt: Faithful Japanese Lighthouse light-theme redesign of Linear team access and permissions, near square 816x828. Header Access and permissions translated as 「アクセスと権限」 plus exact admin-owner subtitle; Team access has the Make public action and disabled invite-required membership setting; Team permissions has four exact rows for Settings, Labels, Templates and Member management, preserving values All team members (first three) and Only team owners (last). White surfaces, ink/secondary text, slate icons, subtle dividers. Official gradient #174C36/#1F6444/#2D8F5E only on primary public action and small section markers. No tint, extra rows or values.
reviewNotes: Reviewed against saved Linear screenshot. Preserves team visibility and membership state, visibility action, all four permission labels/descriptions, first three all-member values, final owners-only value, and disabled membership control. White surfaces, slate text/icons and restrained Lighthouse gradient action/markers checked. Image-generation proposal only; source has no native editable asset or runtime evidence.
